node_keys.tip: tooltip; ABSENT means fall back to `t`

caveats: Node records carry NO cluster label: join `c` against clusters.json (v1's nodes.json had `cl`).
Panel fields are omitted when empty -- render conditionally, never as a blank section.
`tip` is absent when it would equal `t`; fall back to the title.
UMAP is refit whenever the corpus changes, so region positions move between builds.
Not every region is AI-security core. clusters.json carries `ai_security`: false marks an adjacent-ML region the KB does not count as in-scope. Adjacent regions are the ones without a `label_note`.
provenance.verified_at is absent on the older review batch; those carry provenance.date_note instead. Render one or the other -- never invent a date.
